high_level_description: This image is a fashion photograph featuring a person posing against a white wooden backdrop. The individual is wearing a sheer, light pink top with lace detailing on the shoulders and sleeves. They also have on black, sparkly, high-waisted pants that extend to the ankles. The person is wearing black high-heeled shoes with red accents on the heels. The setting appears to be outdoors, as indicated by the stone pavement at the base of the wooden wall and a bicycle wheel partially visible on the right side of the frame.
